series_diffs: Garbage bags and netting are slightly more translucent and materially realistic than the predominantly matte clay surfaces in the reference set.
Background depth is a little shallower and cleaner than the denser miniature-diorama environments in the town and outdoor-scene references.
issues: The garbage bags and mesh net lean mildly toward simulated plastic and woven material rather than fully unified clay construction, creating a small material-consistency drift.
The blank circular sign is visually safe and contains no prohibited text, but its prominence may imply missing UI information if no label or explanation is supplied separately.
